title: Master CSS 'text-overflow' for Elegant UI Truncation & Improved UX
tweet: Don't let long text break your UI! Master CSS 'text-overflow' to gracefully truncate content and maintain a clean design. Elevate your #CSS typography & #UIDesign for better #WebFonts #UX.
tip: For seamless text truncation, always combine 'text-overflow: ellipsis;' with 'white-space: nowrap;' and 'overflow: hidden;' on your block-level or inline-block element. This ensures text is cut off cleanly with an ellipsis without wrapping, crucial for constrained UI components like navigation items or data tables.
